description: Reverse-ETL sink — POST DataFrame rows as Klaviyo profile updates via the async bulk profile-import job endpoint. Two source shapes (upstream_asset_key OR inline source). Reserved fields (email, phone_number, external_id, first_name, ...) land at the top level; everything else nests under `properties`.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

api_revision.description: Inline auth: API revision date (Klaviyo pins behavior per date).
api_revision.label: API Revision

list_id.label: List ID
list_id.description: Optional Klaviyo list id to add all profiles to.

fields_map.description: Explicit source_col -> klaviyo_field mapping. Reserved fields (email, phone_number, external_id, first_name, last_name, organization, title, image, location) land at the top level; everything else is nested under `properties`.
fields_map.label: Fields Map

email_column.description: Column with the user's email address (Klaviyo's primary identifier for most workflows).
email_column.label: Email Column

phone_column.description: Column with the user's phone number (E.164 format).
phone_column.label: Phone Column

external_id_column.description: Column with your customer id (Klaviyo secondary identifier).
external_id_column.label: External ID Column

property_columns.description: For legacy pass-through (no fields_map): which columns become Klaviyo custom properties. Default: all columns except the identifier columns.
property_columns.label: Property Columns

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.
kinds.label: Kinds

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before the asset is considered stale. Defines a FreshnessPolicy.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag Minutes

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays at 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b,customer_c'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

name: Klaviyo Profile Upsert
